name: City of Portland Bureau of Environmental Services (Columbia Boulevard WWTP and combined sewer system)
notification_channel: CSO Advisories and Sewage Advisories on portland.gov/bes/news (RSS https://www.portland.gov/bes/news/rss); Big Pipe Tracker; GovDelivery email list ORPORTLAND_ENT 39493
